newsitem.title: USA: Energy Conversion, Canon sign battery pact.
newsitem.headline: Energy Conversion, Canon sign battery pact.

text.p: Energy Conversion Devices, Inc said Thursday its Ovonic Battery unit has granted Japan's Canon Inc a non-exclusive license to manufacture and market batteries using Ovonic's nickel-metal-hydride technology for certain applications.
In addition to initial upfront fees, Ovonic Battery said it will receive running royalties from Canon, but did not disclose any amounts.
Energy Conversion Devices and Canon already have a joint venture, United Solar Systems Corp, for the production and marketing of photovoltaic products.
